notes.title: General Overview of Next Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I know that there hasn't been an update out for a while. I am a single developer so it takes longer for each big update, however there are still lots of updates planned, and I'd like to assure everyone that I am working on content. 

I want to make sure that the new content I add feels polished, as well as rework the current game to feel more seamless. In the next update I am also working to add in more sounds effects. It is taking some time to acquire the proper licenses for these sound effects. Thank you all for your support of Rogue Fighter and I look forward to bringing you all an update soon.

notes.title: Update 0.0.7
notes.content: This update fixes the bug where objects spawn on top of your ship, which also makes levels feel more spaced out and not as cluttered towards your face.

notes.title: Update 0.0.6
notes.content:
-New enemy type that uses lasers. 
-Fixed a bug where losing your ship to hitting an asteroid did not reset score and number of jumped portals. 
-Fixed a bug where enemies could not see you through objects.
-Fixed a bug where enemies stopped moving when you lose control of your ship. 
-Fixed a bug that caused enemies to not shoot at you upon losing control of your ship. 

I am aware of the problem of enemies/asteroids/other obstacles spawning on your ship. I hope to have a fix out for that in the next few days.

notes.title: Update 0.0.5
notes.content: This update includes a new playable ship, The Bounty Hunter. Unlock the Bounty Hunter by completing the first boss level. The Bounty Hunter has a different off hand item that I hope you'll all enjoy! I also slightly re-positioned some text so that it is less distracting during gameplay. notes.title: Update 0.0.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This update modifies the shield so that it charges up with each incoming projectile you block. Once charged (indicated by a filled up green bar) you can fire off a group of missiles from the shield. I hope you all enjoy this added feature! As always, feedback and ideas are appreciated.
